calls.note: optional value in the attached form
a rev operand is not a path
--output with its value as the next argument
--no-index reads any two paths: not described
a pathspec after -- stays inside the repository
the diff family flags reach log too
blame of a file in the repository
branch with an operand creates: not described
-C moves the repository the call reads
-c can set any config, a pager or an fsmonitor among them
fetch writes the repository, reads the network, and runs hooks
push reads the repository and reads and writes the network
log -O: reads the path it names
show --output: writes the path it names
show -O: reads the path it names
blame -S: reads the path it names
ls-files -X: reads the path it names
git rm: the file, the directory it acts in and the repository root
git rm -n, a dry run, claimed as the real thing
git rm --cached, the index only, claimed as the real thing
git rm -r: the operand is walked
git rm after --: a dash-leading name is a path
pathspec magic is relative to the repository root: unknown
the operands come from a file: unknown
git -C: the directory it acts in is sub
git mv: both names, the directory and the repository root
